analyzed_vuln.description: Heap buffer overflow during GSUB subsetting is caused by Script table serialization writing fields past the end of the preallocated output buffer. In hb_subset.cc, _subset2<OT::GSUB> allocates a fixed-size serialize buffer based on an estimated table size, but OT::Script::subset (called via RecordListOf<Script>::subset and OffsetTo::serialize_subset) emits more bytes than that estimate for this malformed input. The immediate crash is BEInt<unsigned short,2>::set at hb-machinery.hh:674 writing 1 byte out of bounds, but the root cause is incorrect size accounting/under-allocation before Script::subset writes.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Triggered by hb-subset-fuzzer with a crafted font containing a malformed GSUB Script/ScriptList structure. Data flow: fuzzer input -> hb_face -> hb_subset -> _subset2<OT::GSUB const> allocates serializer buffer (hb_vector_t<char>::alloc) -> GSUBGPOS::subset -> RecordListOf<Script>::subset -> Script::subset writes LangSys/defaultLangSys-related serialized data. If serialized Script data exceeds the earlier computed allocation, a write occurs at the end of the heap buffer (ASan shows 0 bytes past a 1353-byte allocation).
